results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 as the card instantiates it: AIT-QA inside band, ordering kept; InfoTabs outside band, ordering flipped; human double-coding pending

reproducibility_frictions_observed: the GPT chat wrapper was never released (only {instruction, input} items), so the envelope is a documented paraphrase - the README alpaca wrapper as one user message
the paper names 'GPT-4-turbo' with no snapshot and no code in the repository calls OpenAI at all; the snapshot is an inference by the date rule
aitqa.py credits a 'gpt-4' root_dir once for `gold in pred` and again for `pred == gold`, so the branch that produced 88.57 can exceed 100 and is not the rule TAMA's own checkpoints were scored under
the evaluation data is absent from the repository (no datasets/tama_instruct/): AIT-QA and InfoTabs must be pulled upstream and re-derived with the repository's seeded scripts
src/src/evaluation/utils/utils.py hard-codes absolute /code/ paths and one active root_dir
Table-Syn S1 (80.20) is unreconstructible: process_s1.py consumes a Table-GPT test_All.jsonl that was never released, so only 2 of the 3 author-run GPT cells can be re-executed
no released generated_predictions.jsonl for any model, so drift is measurable at the accuracy level only
the gpt-3.5-turbo half of the paper's two-model yardstick is dead (all snapshots retired)
